title: Tea definition migration matrix
invariants: No tea-specific runtime registry or service profile is introduced.
ProductCatalog owns canonical product definitions and values.
Unknown import fields/options/units fail validation or enter review; they never create definitions.
CustomMarkdownText is authoritative only for narrative, history, caveats and source quotations.
ReviewService stores user observations and explicit publication snapshots, not canonical product facts.
